messages:
sam: Hey team — joining Monday as a contract engineer. Quick cluster of questions about security onboarding before I start:
- When do I get the security training invite and phishsim?
- I'm being given a loaner Mac, but my work requires Ubuntu. Can I run a personal Linux VM, or do contractors need to use the company image only?
- Who approves temporary MDM exceptions for dev-only workflows?

olivia: Welcome, sam :wave:
Short answers: training invite gets sent 48 hrs before start, phishsim cadence is monthly. For the VM/MDM part, need security sign-off + a ticket to IT. I'll loop them in.

maria: Hi @sam — for contractors we prefer company-managed images for sensitive data access. If it's strictly local dev w/o prod creds, we can allow a locked-down VM but it requires:
- a short security review (15-30m)
- a signed contractor addendum (we'll email you)
- no key material stored on the VM

sam: @maria thanks. The contractor addendum — is that separate from the contractor agreement I already signed?

maria: It's an internal security addendum (just one page) that explicitly documents allowed device setups. People Ops will route it to you. :ok_hand:

leo: @sam IT here — if you need Ubuntu, we can image the loaner with a dual-boot or provision an encrypted VM on the Mac with our company baseline. For the VM approach, here's the minimal setup we require:
```
- Disable shared folders
- Enable FileVault on the host
- Use company VPN profile (split-tunnel = off)
- Install company MDM agent and sysmon
```
Open a ticket at https://it.redwood.internal/tickets with subject "Contractor device exception - sam" and include the laptop serial + planned workflow.

sam: Got it. Is the VPN policy strict for contractors? I do a lot of remote services on custom ports.

maria: Contractors get the same default VPN rules as full-time engineers. If you need port exceptions we do a short review and grant them per-session or per-host with justification. We avoid permanent wide-open rules.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: sam added to "monthly-newjoiner" cohort. First simulated phish will arrive ~5 business days after first_message_ts. Training link will be delivered if you fail a simulated phish.

sam: Cool, thanks. Last quick one — is there a checklist I should run through before Day 1?

olivia: Yes — quick checklist we email but TL;DR:
1) Accept invites (SSO + Google)
2) Complete security micro-training (20m)
3) Enroll laptop in MDM within 48 hrs
4) Confirm VPN and MFA are working
5) Upload contractor addendum (we'll provide)
I'll DM you the checklist and the ticket link.

sam: Appreciate it everyone, I'll open the IT ticket now and watch for the addendum. :raised_hands:
